# Phase Two — Candidate File Map

## Read before touching
- All `geelooy/api/olam-h3/**` server handlers and provider helpers.
- `scripts/api/**` browser proxy client.
- `scripts/domain/**` request builders, validators, assets, pricing, readiness.
- Reference and asset UI modules plus their event controllers.
- Current glass/compact/reference CSS and `DirectorStyles.js`.
- Unit and browser tests that cover provider, assets, references, generation, and mobile geometry.

## Likely new modules after inspection
- API contract constants / capability policy if existing code mixes schema knowledge across layers.
- Media reference validator focused on official H3 media constraints.
- Asset image-update coordinator if replacement currently spans multiple UI responsibilities.
- A small futuristic rectangle/glass CSS module rather than bloating existing files.
- API contract tests that exercise every local route without requiring a real paid MiniMax request.

## Safety boundaries
- Never expose `MINIMAX_API_KEY` to browser code.
- Do not fabricate a real paid upstream test while production key is absent.
- Use mocked/upstream-stub verification for complete request/response contracts.
- Preserve unrelated staged work through an isolated clean worktree.
- Full-file rewrites only; no partial patching.
